findings.title: Feature-flagged table widgets discard their query results
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch passes an empty `columns` array and empty `tableData` instead of the current `result`'s fields, metadata, and rows. Consequently, every dashboard table widget for organizations with this feature enabled renders blank even when the query returned data. Pass the actual result data and columns to the new visualization.

findings.title: Zero-valued age or timestamp bypasses the mutual-exclusion check
findings.body: These checks use truthiness to detect whether the other field was supplied. Since `timestamp: 0` and `age: 0` are valid integer values, a report containing both `age: 0` and `timestamp: 0` passes validation, despite the Reporting API formats requiring exactly one of those fields. Check field presence instead, so mixed-format reports are rejected consistently.
